additionalDefects.cause: Test-R18ZT1RequestIdUniquenessV2.ps1 read selected ZIP JSON members including RESULT.json but emitted zipPayloadOrImageMembersRead=false.

additionalDefects.cause: Collector final-root recovery verified the extracted signature and payloads but did not require the recovered PORTAL_RESPONSE_MANIFEST.json and signature hashes to equal the selected response archive envelope hashes.
additionalDefects.prevention: Hash both recovered envelope files and require exact equality to the already authenticated selected archive manifest and signature hashes before citing that archive.

additionalDefects.cause: A publish-gate path of the wrong type and a final-extraction path of the wrong type could be treated as absent instead of invalid.

additionalDefects.cause: P4 PowerShell evidence did not pin the final invocation hash and its checks predated the frozen invocation.

additionalDefects.cause: P4 evidence timestamps did not represent a monotonic generation order.
